title: Garlicky Tempeh, Artichoke, and Spinach Couscous Skillet
intro: This hearty, plant-based dinner provides lasting energy and fullness by pairing protein-dense tempeh with fiber-rich whole-wheat couscous and artichokes.

ingredients.name: Low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add crumbled tempeh and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
Reduce heat to medium. Stir in minced garlic, dried oregano, sun-dried tomatoes, and quartered artichoke hearts, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the garlic is fragrant.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Add baby spinach and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted.
Stir in dry whole-wheat couscous, ensuring it is fully moistened by the broth and mixed with the vegetables.
Remove the skillet from the heat and cover tightly with a lid.
Uncover the skillet after resting and fluff the couscous mixture with a fork. Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the top before serving.
variation: Swap the baby spinach for fresh arugula or baby kale.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat briefly in the microwave.
